agent.summary:
Mitigated. A 1 GiB namespace memory quota blocked the ad pod, causing frontend failures and TargetDown.

Raised the quota to 12 GiB, restored ad, and increased its CPU limit to one core to resolve slow startup.

Verified storefront and API responses return HTTP 200, ad metrics are healthy, and generated traffic has zero current failures. Accounting’s alert includes idle Kafka waiting time; chatbot and MCP are reachable but lack traffic.
